concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-metronome-api-reference-customers-fetch-billing-provider-configurations-for-a-customer]] - customer-scoped billing-provider configuration lookup, contract selector identity, archive-state visibility, and exact provider, delivery, and invoice-suppression schema routes
warnings: The request offers include_archived but documents no default; do not state that the response always includes or excludes archived configurations.
This read endpoint does not prove that a returned configuration is currently selected by a contract or that downstream invoice delivery occurred.
